rationale:
Evidence: iteration 6 (base_speed 1.0, kd 0.30, search_left, sensors at ±0.05 m, sensor_size 0.016) scored 85.60, the best so far. Oval progress rose to 0.3425 (from 0.318 at speed 1.2), so the Evaluator's condition (a) for keeping speed 1.0 is met on progress. Oval line-loss events are 0.0 and oval max_error is 0.0623, still just above the 0.06 m off-track limit. Oval steering_oscillation is 0.1917, well above the 0.15 guide. s-bend and slalom still show one line-loss event each (progress 0.1625 and 0.110), so the recovery direction and speed are not limiting them.

The Evaluator's condition (c) applies: oscillation is above 0.15 while oval max_error is still at or above 0.06. The requested fix is to reduce controller.kd from 0.30 to about 0.20, with every other field fixed. Iteration 1 showed kd 0.30 pushed oscillation above 0.15, and this iteration confirms it. I am changing only kd, so the race isolates the damping effect. I am not changing the sensor layout yet. The Evaluator's condition (d) (a fifth forward sensor or a wider spread for s-bend/slalom) depends on the result of this race, and s-bend/slalom progress is small, so it is a lower-priority lever.

Expected result: oval steering_oscillation falls from 0.19 toward 0.15 or below, and oval max_error drops toward or below 0.06 because the steering is less jittery at the corner entries. Oval progress may fall slightly (lower damping), so the watch value is 0.3425. Hypotheses: (a) kd 0.20 brings oval oscillation below 0.15 while progress stays at or above about 0.32; (b) oval max_error falls below 0.06 on more seeds; (c) s-bend and slalom progress stay near 0.16 and 0.11. Measurements next: oval progress, max_error, steering_oscillation and line_loss_events; s-bend and slalom line_loss_events and progress.
